purpose: Compare GGF with capacity-matched baselines without changing endpoints after observing results. An advantage is a hypothesis, not an output requirement.

category_split.reference: Native SLiCS has 37/38 guided dictionaries. Keep it separately marked capacity-unmatched, per explicit user choice. Reuse seed21 after exact verification; missing reference orders do not become main all75 endpoints.

models.excluded: No 75-unit slices of larger banks. No Concept-SAE main comparison until exact total-token capacity match. Historical 1024 results remain separate.

full_category.reuse: Exact existing fixed-budget GGF75 and SLiCS75 orders21-23

category_split.folds: Exact original SHA category partition and its reverse. Objects may appear unlabeled in reconstruction; this is withheld supervision, not withheld visual exposure.

training.initialization: GGF uses TRAIN foreground SVD initialization. Vanilla and Supervised Vanilla share their own random reconstruction warm-up. This is the native method distinction, not identical supervision. Full-category historical GGF warm-up used known patches; label-free Vanilla cannot use annotation-derived crowd exclusions. Disclose this difference.
training.supervised_selection: Order21 only, independently per regime/fold, guided development only: highest final Capture+0.2 AP within warm MSE+2%; otherwise retain minimum MSE and disclose. Freeze selected weights for orders22-23. Preserve all candidates. Fixed final endpoints; no coherence/test-based selection.
training.learning_rate_scope: New baselines use the declared common continuation LR, not a claim of per-method optimality. Historical GGF75 LR was previously development selected; report tuning compute and sensitivity before a broad optimal-method claim.
training.vanilla_fold_reuse: The same label-free category-split Vanilla endpoint serves both folds, counted once for training and dependence. It is not automatically reused in full-category because the training recipes differ.
training.category_leakage: Excluded annotations removed before masks, crowd/ignore arrays, SVD initialization, targets, supervision, development and weight selection. No full-category supervised warm-start in category-split GGF/SV.
training.resume: Exact model, Adam, controller, image/noise RNG and source/config fingerprints; read-back-verified two-slot journal. No overwrite of original sources.

data.backbone: Original pinned DINOv3 final patch features, 196x768; exact original positional normalization and split identities
data.image_split_rule: Reuse source allocations only after identity/disjointness verification. Train/development/calibration/audit ID sets disjoint. Existing data have prior researcher exposure; no new confirmatory-data claim.
data.labels: Lock 75 category definitions before new response-linked reviews. For concentration use independent crop-only yes/no/unclear/missing presence judgments on calibration and audit. Existing judgments may be reused only for exact crop pixels/IDs/definitions and validated provenance. COCO masks define a separate annotated-category AP endpoint, not automatic human semantic ground truth.
data.fresh_pool: All 640 previously allocated interpretability images have been opened. A future independent generalization study needs a newly frozen allocation.

coherence.primary: Specific-semantic pair consistency: semantic yes / all planned pairs, with no/unclear/missing reported and unresolved upper bounds. All 75 native groups per bank, three fixed image pairs per group. Generic color/edge/orientation alone is not specific semantic agreement.
coherence.secondary: Visual-property pair consistency, explicitly allowing shared texture/form/geometric structure; scored separately with its own yes/no/unclear codes. A coherent visual feature can lack object-category specificity.
coherence.view_selection: Six strongest AUDIT images per native group by signed mean-top4, deterministic image-ID ties. Hash-shuffle the six planned slots using the fixed all75-pair-v1 salt and opaque group key; pair adjacent shuffled slots into three disjoint pairs. Retain missing slots. Use the same prespecified eligible image pool for all methods. Freeze image IDs, positive-top4 patch overlays and opaque randomized presentation before any new judgments. No category/method names. No unit replacement based on appearance, response magnitude or coherence. This is a new fixed matched sample, not a reuse or revision of historical pair outcomes.
coherence.annotation: Three fresh blinded AI contexts per pair, majority yes/no/unclear. Keep individual labels, provenance and disagreements; no independent-human claim. A fixed blinded human validation subset must be sampled before AI labels; human review is not pooled into the AI endpoint.
coherence.other_rubrics: Broader 5-of-6 C/P/U/? reviews remain separate. Parts and cross-category structure are legitimate; category assignment is never used as the unit's semantic label.

concentration.pooling: Arithmetic mean of largest four SIGNED native responses over all196 positions; no clipping or zeroing. All75 candidates remain eligible for every target.
concentration.support: At least5 determinate positives and10 determinate negatives in EACH calibration/audit split. Retain all75 categories and every low-support status; undefined metrics are null, never zero or omitted.
concentration.threshold: Calibration-negative numpy quantile(method=higher), strict response>threshold; ties negative.
concentration.selector: Descending calibration balanced accuracy=.5*(TPR+1-FPR), ties ascending native unit ID. Lock all thresholds, full rankings and budget selections before audit scoring. OR across selected groups, never sum dictionary vectors or call this information recovery.
metrics: positive/negative support Jaccard with zero-union counts
concentration.summary: Equal-category means only over explicitly supported categories, retaining all category support tables; same label-support set across methods. No activity weighting. Native category-split SLiCS uses all37/38 candidates and is separately capacity-unmatched.

target_alignment.selector: Use the same calibration balanced-accuracy top group as concentration q=.95 budget1, across all methods. No reconstruction proxy, intended slot or audit outcome selector.
target_alignment.evidence: Six strongest calibration and six strongest audit views per selected link, deterministic ties. Review and lock calibration alignment before audit alignment. Target must dominate the marked region; target elsewhere in image is insufficient.
target_alignment.score: Confirmed target / all planned views; unresolved upper bound includes mixed/unclear/missing, not a confidence interval. Keep every category/link and pending evidence. Target alignment and generic coherence remain separate.

category_AP.role: Additional annotated category-alignment endpoint, reported separately from visual target alignment and capture.
category_AP.selector: Best existing native unit by maximum calibration category-mask patch AP, ties smallest native ID; freeze before audit. Use the same selected unit for AP reporting. No test-selected unit or reconstruction proxy.
category_AP.report: Full196 positions, tied-zero scores retained; per-category AP, prevalence, AP lift and within-positive-image AP. Guided and excluded category strata separately in category-split; all fixed category denominators and null support statuses.

controls: Original regional Capture with its separately locked readout; do not substitute it for AP
distinct represented concepts, duplication and unresolved coverage
training/inference time and peak GPU memory
update/example/tuning budgets and actual initialization/supervision differences
description_fit_secondary: If frozen free-form descriptions are collected, separately report marked-patch description fit in high and lower-response audit examples, description coverage and enrichment over controls. Lock descriptions before audit evidence; preserve unresolved/no-description groups. Do not replace whole-bank pair coherence with a mean conditional on interpreted groups. Unseen-image prediction is a later separately allocated test, not a substituted coherence score.
analysis: Report all methods, orders and category folds without pooling incompatible protocols. Average pairs within groups before group-level analyses. Shared images, repeated groups, orders sharing initialization, repeated Vanilla across folds and AI contexts are not independent replications. Show effects and appropriate conditional uncertainty; predeclare any later inferential superiority claim and multiplicity family before new outcomes. No posthoc composite winner.
production_gates: All required endpoints frozen before calibration/audit collection
Blinded view/sample lock before coherence labels
Complete independently validated presence-label lock before concentration scoring
Calibration-only selection lock before audit scores
Explicit pending statuses for uncollected visual/semantic outcomes
completion: Training-stage completion produces verified endpoint catalog only. The dashboard is complete only after all required scoring/annotation gates pass. Do not report synthetic fixtures as experimental results.
